ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Extremely low; approximately 95% low-intensity (near-black) pixels with high-intensity white pixel clusters localized only at the distal tips.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Uniform dark pigmentation across both lobes; distinct high-contrast white circular clusters located at the distal tips (coordinates: top-left and top-right extremities).

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Wide V-shaped depression; central vertex angle is approximately 125 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Asymmetrical topography; left lobe trailing edge features 3-4 deep, irregular indentations (notches), while the right lobe features smaller, higher-frequency serrations.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Strong convex curve sweeping upward and tapering to sharp points at the distal ends.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-contrast circular clusters of white pixels concentrated on the outermost edges of both the left and right fluke tips.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Faint, light-grey linear streaks oriented horizontally across the mid-right lobe surface.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent irregular notch/trauma on the trailing edge of the left lobe; heavy barnacle colonization at both fluke tips.
other_distinctive_markers: Partial pixel blurring and low-contrast streaks on the right lobe caused by water spray/mist occlusion.
